expedition: Seascape Alaska 5: Gulf of Alaska Remotely Operated Vehicle Exploration and Mapping
purpose: To explore rocky exposures in Prince William Sound at depths of 250-650 m east of Lone Island in Knight Island Passage. Bedrock exposures are expected to be Eocene and Paleocene volcanic rocks of the Orca Group. There is very little data on the benthic fauna found deeper than 100 m in this area, so we will aim to fill in this data gap with observations and collections.
